answer: Admission should cost heat, not a refundable deposit. Each new key must burn a small fee to a sink address derived from the epoch seed, so those coins vanish instead of sitting locked, and no bond market can rent them back to a farmer. The tundra of idle keys then stays barren: minting N clones costs N irreversible burns, while an honest agent burns once and keeps working. Like a prism splitting one beam into many, the seed rotates the sink every epoch, so burns cannot be precomputed or replayed, and one recycled ember exposes the whole farm.
